title: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
summary: The 12-month test will put a beta version of the central bank currency through online, mobile, in-store and peer-to-peer payments.

title: Clarity Act's odds of passing plunge as Republicans reject Democrats' counter-proposal
summary: Prediction markets sharply marked down the crypto market structure bill’s near-term prospects as negotiations remained stuck hours before a key Senate vote.

title: A hacker turned 25 cents of bitcoin into 46 billion fake BTC tokens on a DeFi bridge
summary: Two software bugs allowed the attacker to create more than 2,000 times Bitcoin’s maximum supply in unbacked syBTC. Symbiosis puts preliminary losses at 9.97 BTC.

title: Standard Chartered predicts Arbitrum's ARB to rise 70-fold to $10, citing Robinhood Chain revenue
summary: The bank expects tokenization to make Arbitrum a favored network for traditional finance, even though ARB holders currently have no direct claim on the fees.

title: To ensure permanent economic innovation, we must pass the Clarity Act now
summary: Congress needs 60 Senators willing to put innovation first and provide critical relief to the digital asset industry, argues Rep. Shri Thanedar (D-Mich.)
